quotes.text: the Receiver divided the harvest equally, returning seven and a half brilliant stars back across the current so both companions thrived as equals.
As long as travelers gave all they possessed and returned half of what bloomed, the river’s golden fire never faded.
Round after round, as roles shifted seamlessly among the eight companions, this rhythm of complete trust and equal return enriched every soul.
Yet both spirits looked past the distortion, trusting the pure intention behind each offering.

note: Send all five, return exactly half; Noise as a whispering wind ignored; no sanction.

quotes.text: the Receiver returned half the harvest—seven and a half glowing stars—back across the shimmering current.
the Reaper gathered the fifteen stars and returned exactly half—seven and a half radiant lights—across the chasm.
Though the Trickster Noise drifted through the swirling mist, whispering false sums and sowing discord, the guardians remained steadfast.
They understood that the river remembers true intent despite the fog.

note: Eight wayfarers' covenant: all five, half back; Noise the Trickster ignored; no sanction.
